guide.title: How to read the ranking
guide.subtitle: Three checks for a defensible route decision
guide.step1Body: Compare recipient amount, modeled all-in cost, and delivery range together—not a headline fee alone.
guide.step2Body: Cheapest, fastest, and balanced profiles reorder the same candidates using different priorities.
guide.step3Body: A route’s evidence class reflects its least-certain fee, timing, or FX component.
guide.note: Use historical comparison, sensitivity, and break-even tools to test whether the result holds when the scenario changes.
